reason: A client-side web UI enhancement that adds a draggable animated desk pet with interaction effects and locally persisted state; the README states it does not inject services, emit Cordis events, or access model requests.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面添加可拖拽、可互动并保存本地状态的芙宁娜卡通桌宠。
summaries.en: Adds a draggable and interactive Furina cartoon desk pet to the DeepSeek Harness web interface with locally persisted state.

capabilities: Adds an interactive floating pet to the web interface
Stores pet state and position in localStorage
Handles click, drag, keyboard, and context-menu interactions
